headline: An actor is fined for an alcohol brand in his personal posts.
body: Yiğit Dören was fined 82,244 lira after an alcohol brand appeared in his personal social media posts. He has appealed.
why: It shows personal accounts can be penalised, not only companies. The 2026 range for promotion offences is 103,207 to 4,130,222 lira. The court's decision on his appeal is the thing to watch.
